explanation: Lens, Shutter, Aperture, and Sensor are all integral internal components or fundamental functions of a camera directly involved in the process of capturing an image. A Tripod is an external accessory used for camera stabilization.

All tokens except 'Great Pyramid of Giza' represent Wonders of the Ancient World that have been destroyed or lost over time, existing only as ruins or historical accounts. The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the original seven wonders that is still largely intact and standing today.
Foot, Inch, Yard, and Mile are all units of length within the Imperial and US customary systems of measurement. Liter is a unit of volume in the metric system.
